scope: Bounded read-only GFA software-identity read through the production splitter MQTT command path.

proven: P81, P82 and P83 are readable on the local VDensHO1/20C2 appliance through the guarded production GFA_READ path.
P81 raw value is 0x02, P82 raw value is 0x06 and P83 raw value is 0x76.
The local GFA branch remained P80=0x20 before and after the read sequence.
not_proven: Official human-readable firmware notation such as 2.6 or 02.06.
A marketing/release name corresponding to P81/P82.
Complete, contradiction-free semantic decoding of P83 0x76; a partial source bit mapping exists but bit4 does not fit the retained description.

p83_static_followup.source_description: Gerätekonfiguration (FA0...7); bit-position text: b0=not(FA1), b1=FA5, b2=FA3, b3=FA0, b4=0, b5=FA2, b6=FA7, b7=FA6
p83_static_followup.interpretation_boundary: Partial source mapping recovered, but do not claim a complete semantic decode: the retained description labels bit4 as 0/reserved while local raw 0x76 has bit4 set.
